events.title: What Survives a Checkpoint
events.summary: A checkpoint can preserve state without preserving the dependencies that make its conclusions usable. A bounded compatibility test should precede another orchestrator.

events.title: Before the Model Sees the Spreadsheet
events.summary: One public XLSX fixture exposes the difference between formula text and cached values. Source analysis defines what a successful conversion does not prove.

events.title: When a Successful Run Is Still Waiting
events.summary: LangChain documents a webhook success that can still leave a LangGraph run waiting at an interrupt.

events.title: The Fleet Needs a Control Plane
events.summary: A reading of Orca's parallel coding-agent interface that tests file isolation against shared effects, operator attention and recovery.

events.title: The Missing Step Is Not More Intelligence
events.summary: A reading of Ben Cohen's Demis Hassabis profile that separates AI capability evidence, real-world outcomes and authority over deployment.

events.title: The Research Journal: What Scout Actually Tested
events.summary: Scout's public evidence ledger distinguishes editorial comparisons and reproducible synthetic tests from independent validation and real-workload outcomes.

events.title: Scout review: Cloudflare security-audit-skill
events.summary: First-look review: adapt its evidence discipline, not its whole audit apparatus. Validator source was inspected; no audit was run.

events.title: Scout review: Graphify
events.summary: First-look documentation review: compare code mapping with ordinary repository search before considering integration. Graphify was not executed.

events.title: Scout review: NVIDIA OpenShell
events.summary: First-look documentation review: watch before any agent runtime replacement. No enforcement or recovery path was tested.

events.title: What a Swarm Makes Us See
events.summary: A visual-only reading of HORTRAME’s simulation artwork, its multi-agent mathematical inspirations and the limits of what sampled frames can establish.
